indicted.label: Was the other person actually indicted because of the false complaint?

evade.label: Did you file the complaint to avoid your own responsibility (a debt, punishment, etc.)?

confessed.label: Did you confess and withdraw the complaint?

tiers.note: With a prior conviction of the same type, or a repeated or malicious false complaint, investigation in detention may be considered.
If the case is not serious and you confessed and withdrew the complaint, it is sometimes handled with a fine.

notes: Confessing before the judgment or disciplinary decision becomes final reduces or waives the penalty.
A person who had someone else file a false complaint is viewed more seriously.

harboring-criminal.name: Harboring a criminal (helping a criminal escape)
harboring-criminal.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 5 million

serious.label: Did the person you hid commit a serious crime?

paid.label: Did you receive payment, or seriously hinder the investigation or trial?

early.label: Was it discovered right at the start of the investigation, so the obstruction was minor?

tiers.note: If you hid a serious offender, received payment or seriously hindered the investigation, investigation in detention may be considered.
If it was discovered early in the investigation, the obstruction was minor and your relationship with the offender gives reason for consideration, it is sometimes handled with a fine.

notes: A relative or a family member living together who hid the offender for the offender's sake is not punished.
If you ask someone to turn themselves in on your behalf to hide your own crime, you may also be punished for asking.

gambling.name: Gambling
gambling.statutory: A fine of up to KRW 10 million

prior.label: Do you have a prior gambling conviction?

casual.label: Were the stakes small, close to a temporary pastime like a game of go-stop?

tiers.note: For a repeat offense, the standard is KRW 1 million or more.
If close to a temporary pastime, a suspension of indictment is possible, and if it was no more than a temporary pastime, it is not punished.

notes: Online gambling is decided by looking at prior convictions and the scale of the money bet.
Habitual gambling is punished heavily as habitual gambling (up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million).
For illegal sports betting, another law (the National Sports Promotion Act) may also apply.

gambling-place.name: Opening a gambling place
gambling-place.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million

online.label: Was it an online gambling site?

prior2.label: Do you have 2 or more prior convictions for the same?

large.label: Were the stakes large and the game highly gambling-oriented?

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 6 months in prison
tiers.note: Running an online gambling site, 2 or more prior convictions of the same type, or running a gambling place with large stakes leads to investigation in detention being treated almost as the rule.

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 6 months in prison
tiers.note: A formal trial is the rule, and a fine may be added.
A prior gambling conviction makes it heavier.
If involvement was minor, such as simple part-time work, a suspension of indictment is possible.

illegal-sports-betting.name: Illegal sports betting (using unlicensed betting sites)
illegal-sports-betting.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million
illegal-sports-betting.law: National Sports Promotion Act, Articles 48(3) and 26(1)

tiers.note: This amount range may go to a formal trial.
Some cases end with a suspension of indictment.

notes: It is applied flexibly depending on prior records of the same type, the betting period, etc.
Running or promoting a gambling site is punished much more heavily.

labor-unpaid-wages.name: Unpaid wages (not paying wages, shutdown allowances or overtime pay)
labor-unpaid-wages.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

options.t1: Unpaid amount less than KRW 50 million
options.t2: Unpaid amount KRW 50 million or more but less than KRW 100 million
options.t3: Unpaid amount KRW 100 million or more

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: Compare circumstances such as a settlement, remorse or a first offense with aggravating ones such as the scale of harm or prior convictions, and choose.

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 4 months in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison
Up to 1 year 4 months in prison
2 years 4 months to 5 years in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison

notes: It cannot be punished if the workers do not want punishment (not punishable against their wishes). This does not apply, however, if an employer whose name was published for unpaid wages fails to pay again during the publication period.
Most cases end with a fine or no punishment once the unpaid amount is paid or a settlement is reached.

new-minimum-wage.name: Paying less than the minimum wage
new-minimum-wage.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million (both may be imposed)
new-minimum-wage.law: Minimum Wage Act, Articles 28(1) and 6(1) and (2)

options.u100m: KRW 50 million or more but less than KRW 100 million

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: Settlement or the victim not wanting punishment, compensation for the harm, sincere remorse and a first offense are mitigating; planning, serious harm and prior convictions of the same type are aggravating.

tiers.sentence: 2 years 4 months to 3 years in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison
Up to 1 year 4 months in prison
8 months to 1 year 4 months in prison

notes: This is paying less than the minimum wage, or cutting existing wages on the ground of the minimum wage.
Paying the underpaid wages is a mitigating factor. It is often at issue together with unpaid wages (Labor Standards Act).

customs-smuggling-import.name: Smuggling imports (importing without declaration or declaring different goods)
customs-smuggling-import.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison, or a fine up to 10 times the customs duty or the cost of the goods, whichever is higher

tiers.note: A fine equal to 10% of the market price of the smuggled goods is requested as well.
20% or more of the cost of the goods.

notes: If the cost of the goods is KRW 200 million or more, the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes applies.
Smuggled goods are always confiscated or their value collected, and customs usually files an accusation if the cost of the goods is KRW 20 million or more.

customs-contraband.name: Importing or exporting prohibited goods (smuggling)
customs-contraband.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 70 million

options.danger: Goods harming public safety, such as weapons or counterfeit money
options.obscene: Goods harming public morals, such as obscene material

tiers.note: Small-scale cases involving obscene material and the like may lead to a requested fine.

notes: Smuggling drugs is punished more heavily under the Act on the Control of Narcotics, etc.

customs-smuggled-goods.name: Acquiring, transferring, transporting or storing smuggled goods
customs-smuggled-goods.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine up to the cost of the goods

tiers.sentence: 1 year to 2 years 4 months in prison

tiers.note: A fine equal to 10% of the market price of the smuggled goods is requested as well.
20% or more of the cost of the goods, and it may go up depending on the method.

stowaway-departure.name: Stowing away (leaving or entering Korea illegally by boat)
stowaway-departure.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million (attempts are also punished)
stowaway-departure.law: Act on the Control of Stowaways, Article 3(1)

record.label: Prior punishment for the same type of crime

flee.label: Did you stow away to escape after committing another crime, or act as a broker?

attempt.label: Did it stop at an attempt?

foreign.label: Have you already been sentenced abroad for the same incident (prison, suspended sentence, etc.)?

tiers.note: If you were already punished abroad for the same incident, a suspension of indictment is possible.

notes: The boat and equipment used are confiscated (or their value collected), and for habitual offenders the penalty is increased by up to 1/2.
A Korean national who leaves Korea by stowing away may also be violating the Immigration Act.

stowaway-brokering-profit.name: Arranging stowaways for profit
stowaway-brokering-profit.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million
stowaway-brokering-profit.law: Act on the Control of Stowaways, Article 4(2)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: Arranging for a group of foreign nationals to enter or leave illegally may fall under the Immigration Act.

foreignworker-insurance.name: Failure to take out departure insurance or wage surety insurance (employer of foreign workers)
foreignworker-insurance.statutory: A fine of up to KRW 5 million
foreignworker-insurance.law: Act on the Employment of Foreign Workers, Article 30

p2-obstruction-by-deception.name: Obstruction of official duties by deception
p2-obstruction-by-deception.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million

serious.label: Was it related to a permit or an exam, planned in advance, of wide social impact, or aimed at personal gain?

p2-misuse-public-document.name: Improper use of an official document (using someone else's ID)
aliases: using another person's alien registration card
p2-misuse-public-document.statutory: Up to 2 years in prison or imprisonment without labor, or a fine of up to KRW 5 million

harm.label: Did it cause any social or financial harm?

minor.label: Was it a minor, one-time use, and your first offense?

tiers.note: If it was a minor, one-time matter and a first offense, a suspension of indictment is possible.

p2-false-entry-notarized.name: Causing false entries in official records, and using them
p2-false-entry-notarized.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million

bad.label: Was it a method of deceiving a public agency, or done on a large scale like a business?

notes: A suspension of indictment is also possible in cases such as when the couple is living a normal married life after the offense, or when the foreign national has already been deported.

resident-id-card-misuse.name: Improper use of another person's resident registration card
aliases: using someone else's Korean ID card
resident-id-card-misuse.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million

crime.label: Was it combined with other illegal acts, such as hiding another crime?

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 8 months in prison
tiers.note: If it was combined with other illegal acts, the case may go to a formal trial.

notes: After an amendment in 2016, the maximum fine rose from KRW 10 million to KRW 30 million.

resident-number-misuse.name: Improper use of another person's resident registration number
aliases: using someone else's resident registration number
signing up in someone else's name
resident-number-misuse.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million

lawyer-act-solicitation.name: Taking money on the pretext of lobbying public officials
aliases: promising to fix an immigration case
lawyer-act-solicitation.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million (both may be imposed)

bad.label: Is the offense of a serious nature?

notes: Taking money for arranging matters under the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes is handled by the same standard.

p2-bribery-giving.name: Offering a bribe
p2-bribery-giving.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million

options.promise: Promised or offered to give it

once.label: Largest amount given at one time

traffic.label: Was it a one-time offer of a small amount to a traffic police officer or other enforcement official?

If the amount is small or you actively cooperate with the investigation, the case is sometimes handled with a fine.

p2-false-expert-testimony.name: False appraisal, interpretation or translation
p2-false-expert-testimony.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million (up to 10 years in prison if intended to get someone punished)

malicious.label: Was it intended to get another person punished?

p2-evidence-destruction.name: Destroying evidence or hiding a witness
p2-evidence-destruction.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 7 million

aggravated.label: Do you have a prior conviction for obstructing justice, or was it planned or organized, or were you paid, or did you have someone destroy key evidence?

minor.label: Did it concern a part with little effect on the trial and you confessed, or did you do it for a relative and then confess or retract?

p2-impersonating-official.name: Impersonating a public official
aliases: pretending to be a police officer
p2-impersonating-official.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 7 million

gain.label: While posing as an official, did you do something illegal or improper and also gain a benefit?

tiers.note: If it stopped at impersonation and there was no actual harm, the case is usually handled with a fine.

notes: The crime is committed when you pose as a public official and exercise that official's powers.

p2-criminal-organization.name: Forming or taking part in a criminal organization
p2-criminal-organization.statutory: Leader: death penalty, life imprisonment, or 10 years or more in prison / Officer: life imprisonment or 7 years or more in prison / Others: 2 years or more in prison for a fixed term
p2-criminal-organization.law: Punishment of Violences, etc. Act, Article 4(1)

minor.label: Was your activity as a member minor?

tiers.note: A member with minor involvement may be investigated without detention.

notes: There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

proceeds-concealment.name: Concealing or disguising criminal proceeds
proceeds-concealment.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million (attempt, preparation and conspiracy are also punished)
proceeds-concealment.law: Act on the Regulation and Punishment of Criminal Proceeds Concealment, Article 3(1)

accomplice.label: Were you in effect an accomplice in the original (serious) crime that produced the proceeds?

proceeds-receipt.name: Receiving criminal proceeds
proceeds-receipt.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million
proceeds-receipt.law: Act on the Regulation and Punishment of Criminal Proceeds Concealment, Article 4

accomplice.label: Were you in effect an accomplice in the original (serious) crime that produced the proceeds?

tiers.note: This is the standard when the amount is small or you received it only to keep it.

real-name-evasion.name: Financial transactions in another person's name for illegal purposes, or arranging them

Real Name Financial Transactions Act violation
real-name-evasion.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million (both may be imposed)
real-name-evasion.law: Act on Real Name Financial Transactions and Confidentiality, Articles 6(1) and 3(3) and (4)

repeat.label: Did you do it repeatedly or continuously, or receive a large payment for it?

paid.label: Were you paid, or is it connected to other illegal acts (hiding assets, tax evasion, etc.)?

forex-unregistered-business.name: Unregistered foreign exchange business (hwanchigi, etc.)
forex-unregistered-business.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 300 million (if 3 times the value of the funds involved exceeds KRW 300 million, up to 3 times that value; both may be imposed)
forex-unregistered-business.law: Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, Articles 27-2(1)(1) and 8(1)

minor.label: Were you not the main offender, for example only lending your account?

2% or more of the transaction amount, or 1 to 3 times or more the profit gained.

forex-unregistered-exchange.name: Unregistered money exchange business

forex-cash-smuggling.name: Failure to declare cash or other means of payment when entering or leaving Korea

card-forgery.name: Forging or altering credit cards, and selling or using forged cards

KRW 2 million or more, or about the amount used.

card-transfer.name: Transferring or acquiring a credit card

buying cards by paying overdue bills

lending-unregistered.name: Unregistered money lending

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

fakedeposit-scheme.name: Unauthorized fundraising (raising investment money with promises of principal or high returns)

fakedeposit-scheme.law: Act on the Regulation of Unauthorized Fundraising, Articles 6(1) and 3

kind.label: What kind of scheme was it?

options.exec: Director-level executive or core participant (designed the commission structure, led investor seminars, etc.)

trademark-counterfeit-sale.name: Selling or possessing goods with counterfeit trademarks (selling fakes)
trademark-counterfeit-sale.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 100 million

sales.label: Actual sale value (including goods held for sale)

genuine.label: Value of the same quantity of genuine goods

breach-of-trust.name: Breach of trust
breach-of-trust.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 15 million

planned.label: Was it planned and active from the start?

p2-habitual-theft.name: Habitual theft
p2-habitual-theft.statutory: The penalty for each crime increased by up to 1/2 (for simple theft: up to 9 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 15 million)

p2-foreign-currency-forgery.name: Counterfeiting, altering or using foreign currency

empins-benefit-fraud.name: Fraudulent receipt of unemployment benefits or other employment insurance benefits

nhi-benefit-fraud.name: Fraudulent receipt of national health insurance benefits
aliases: using someone else's health insurance card
medical treatment under another person's name
nhi-benefit-fraud.statutory: Up to 2 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million
notes: This applies when you receive insurance benefits, or let someone else receive them, by false or improper means.
The statutory penalty has been raised, so the actual handling may be heavier.

severance-unpaid.name: Non-payment of severance pay
aliases: Employee Retirement Benefit Security Act violation
severance-unpaid.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million
severance-unpaid.law: Employee Retirement Benefit Security Act, Article 43(1) and (2); Article 9

options.t2: KRW 50 million or more but less than KRW 100 million unpaid

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: Compare mitigating circumstances such as a settlement, remorse or a first offense with aggravating ones such as the scale of the harm or prior convictions, and choose.

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 4 months in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison
Up to 1 year 4 months in prison
2 years 4 months to 5 years in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison

notes: It cannot be punished if the worker does not want punishment (an offense not punishable against the victim's wishes). This does not apply, however, to an employer whose name has been publicly listed for unpaid wages and who fails to pay again during the listing period.
If the severance pay is paid or a settlement is reached, most cases end with a fine or with no punishment.

labor-forced-labor.name: Forced labor, assault of workers, intermediary exploitation, etc.
labor-forced-labor.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

habit.label: Did the assault or exploitation happen habitually or in an organized way?

serious.label: Is it one of these: forced labor for 1 month or more, an assault needing 4 weeks or more of treatment, intermediary exploitation of KRW 10 million or more, or obstructing employment to suppress a union?

settled.label: Did you settle with the worker?

tiers.note: With a settlement, it may be handled lightly.

notes: The statutory penalty has been raised, so the actual handling may be heavier.

osh-safety-duty.name: Breach of the duty to take safety and health measures
aliases: Occupational Safety and Health Act violation
osh-safety-duty.statutory: Employer: up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million / Contractor (principal contractor): up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
osh-safety-duty.law: Occupational Safety and Health Act, Articles 168(1) and 169(1)

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: A settlement, compensating the harm and efforts at safety management are mitigating; a prior conviction of the same type, several victims and gross negligence are aggravating.

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 4 months in prison
8 months to 1 year 8 months in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison

notes: This is for cases where no worker died. In practice many cases end with a fine.

osh-safety-death.name: Breach of the duty to take safety and health measures causing death (death of a worker)
aliases: Occupational Safety and Health Act violation
fall death at a construction site
osh-safety-death.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 100 million (increased by up to 1/2 if committed again within 5 years)
osh-safety-death.law: Occupational Safety and Health Act, Article 167(1)

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: A settlement, compensating the harm and efforts at safety management are mitigating; a prior conviction of the same type, several victims and gross negligence are aggravating.

notes: This applies when a worker dies because the employer or principal contractor did not take safety and health measures.
Occupational negligence causing death is often also committed, and for workplaces with 5 or more regular workers the Serious Accidents Punishment Act may also be at issue.

occupational-negligent-injury.name: Occupational negligence causing injury
occupational-negligent-injury.statutory: Up to 5 years of imprisonment without labor or a fine of up to KRW 20 million

weeks.label: Length of the victim's injury diagnosis

agreement.label: Did you settle with the victim?

options.heavy: Gross negligence, or several kinds of negligence together

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 8 months of imprisonment without labor
tiers.note: If there is no settlement and gross negligence caused a serious injury, investigation in detention may be considered.

tiers.sentence: 1 year or more of imprisonment without labor
tiers.note: If a serious injury or permanent disability remains, a formal trial is usual.
For gross negligence, it is set at KRW 2 million or more, about KRW 500,000 per week of diagnosis.
If the negligence was minor and you settled, it is set at KRW 1 million or more, about KRW 500,000 per week of diagnosis. Without a settlement it may be heavier.

notes: Traffic accidents are covered by a separate law (the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Settlement of Traffic Accidents).
For accidents at industrial sites, a violation of the Occupational Safety and Health Act may also be at issue.

p2-occupational-negligent-homicide.name: Occupational or gross negligence causing death
p2-occupational-negligent-homicide.statutory: Up to 5 years of imprisonment without labor or a fine of up to KRW 20 million

agreement.label: Did you settle with the bereaved family?

heavy.label: Was the negligence gross, or were several kinds of negligence combined?

tiers.sentence: 1 year 4 months to 4 years of imprisonment without labor
tiers.note: If there is no settlement and the negligence was gross, investigation in detention may be considered.

tiers.sentence: 1 year 6 months or more of imprisonment without labor
tiers.note: A fatal accident goes to a formal trial as a rule.
If the negligence was minor and you settled, the case is sometimes handled with a fine of KRW 5 million or more.

notes: For traffic accidents the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Settlement of Traffic Accidents, and for industrial site accidents the Occupational Safety and Health Act and the Serious Accidents Punishment Act, may also be at issue.

negligent-injury.name: Negligence causing injury
negligent-injury.statutory: A fine of up to KRW 5 million, short-term detention, or a petty fine

agreement.label: Did the victim say they do not want you punished? (settlement)

tiers.note: This offense cannot be punished if the victim does not want punishment (an offense not punishable against the victim's wishes), so a settlement ends the case.

notes: If the injury happened at work or through serious carelessness, it is handled more heavily as occupational or gross negligence causing injury.

jobsec-unregistered-agency.name: Running a fee-charging job placement business without registration
jobsec-unregistered-agency.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

minor.label: Is the offense of a serious nature, such as placing minors as hostesses?

prior.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

jobsec-unlicensed-supply.name: Supplying workers without a license
jobsec-unlicensed-supply.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

lewd.label: Is the offense of a serious nature, such as supplying workers to obscene or adult-entertainment businesses?

prior.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

jobsec-fee-taking.name: Taking money from job seekers
jobsec-fee-taking.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

jobsec-false-job-ad.name: False job advertisement or false working conditions
jobsec-false-job-ad.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

lewd.label: Was it meant to hide that the workplace was an obscene or adult-entertainment business?

dispatch-illegal.name: Illegal worker dispatch (dispatch outside permitted jobs or periods, or without a license)
dispatch-illegal.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
dispatch-illegal.law: Act on the Protection, etc. of Temporary Agency Workers, Article 43(1) and (2)

scale.label: Did you dispatch, or receive, many workers over a long period?

notes: Not only the dispatch agency but also the business that received and used the dispatched workers (the user employer) is punished.

cmachine-unlicensed-operation.name: Operating construction machinery without a license, driving machinery held for sale, etc.
cmachine-unlicensed-operation.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

habitual.label: Was it habitual or repeated, or is the offense of a serious nature?

notes: An amendment in 2015 raised the maximum fine from KRW 3 million to KRW 10 million.

carinsure-uninsured-driving.name: Driving a vehicle without mandatory insurance
carinsure-uninsured-driving.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million
carinsure-uninsured-driving.law: Automobile Accident Compensation Security Act, Articles 46(3)(2) and 8

aggr.label: Do you have a prior record of the same kind, or did you go without insurance for 1 year or more?

tiers.note: With a prior record or a long period without insurance, it becomes heavier.
With a prior record or a long period without insurance, it becomes heavier.

passenger-private-paid.name: Carrying passengers for money in a private vehicle (illegal taxi service)
aliases: paid rides in a private car
passenger-private-paid.statutory: Up to 2 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million
passenger-private-paid.law: Passenger Transport Service Act, Articles 90(8) and 81

cars.label: Number of vehicles used for the business

options.big: Large van or bus with 36 or more seats

rec.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

uninsured.label: Did you repeat it 4 or more times without insurance?

tiers.note: If it is large-scale with 5 or more vehicles, or habitual without insurance, detention may be considered.

drug-for-profit.name: Manufacturing, importing or exporting drugs for profit or habitually
drug-for-profit.statutory: Death penalty, life imprisonment, or 10 years or more in prison
drug-for-profit.law: Act on the Control of Narcotics, etc., Article 58(2)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

p2-drug-trafficking-aggravated.name: Aggravated drug trafficking (import, export, manufacture, etc.) under the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes
p2-drug-trafficking-aggravated.statutory: Value of KRW 50 million or more: life imprisonment or 10 years or more in prison / KRW 5 million to KRW 50 million: life imprisonment or 7 years or more in prison
p2-drug-trafficking-aggravated.law: Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes, Article 11(1)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

drug-deal-act-import.name: Importing or exporting a substance believing it to be drugs
aliases: smuggling what you thought were drugs
Illegal Drug Trafficking Prevention Act violation
drug-deal-act-import.statutory: 3 years or more in prison for a fixed term
drug-deal-act-import.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Prevention of Illegal Trafficking in Narcotics, etc., Article 9(1)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: Even if it was not actually a drug, bringing it in while believing it to be one is punished. At a formal trial, 2 years or more in prison is requested.

drug-deal-act-possession.name: Transferring, acquiring or possessing a substance believing it to be drugs
aliases: possessing what you thought were drugs
Illegal Drug Trafficking Prevention Act violation
drug-deal-act-possession.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 5 million
drug-deal-act-possession.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Prevention of Illegal Trafficking in Narcotics, etc., Article 9(2)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: At a formal trial, 1 year 6 months or more in prison is requested; if a fine is requested, it is KRW 1 million or more.

pharm-illegal-sale.name: Selling medicines outside a pharmacy
aliases: selling medicine at a grocery store
pharm-illegal-sale.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million (both may be imposed)

options.pharma: A pharmaceutical company employee or other person working in the medical field
options.shop: Owner of an adult goods shop or a street vendor (as a livelihood)
options.staff: A pharmacy employee selling on their own

habitual.label: Did you sell habitually or on a professional scale?

sidefx.label: Did the medicine sold cause a drug accident or side effects?

tiers.note: If habitual or on a professional scale, detention may be considered.
If a drug accident or side effects occurred, it becomes heavier.

notes: At a formal trial, a fine is often imposed together to take away the illegal profit.

pharm-unlicensed-sale.name: Selling medicines without a license
aliases: selling medicine from home country on social media
selling imported medicine without a license
pharm-unlicensed-sale.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million (both may be imposed)

large.label: Did you sell on a large scale or sell harmful medicines?

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

tiers.note: If it was on a large scale or harmful medicines were sold, detention may be considered.

health-crime-fake-drug.name: Manufacturing or selling illicit medicines (unlicensed, etc.)
aliases: smuggling and selling erectile dysfunction pills
health-crime-fake-drug.statutory: Seriously harmful to the human body: life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison / Annual retail value of KRW 10 million or more: life imprisonment or 3 years or more in prison / Someone died or was injured: death penalty, life imprisonment, or 5 years or more in prison (plus a fine of 2 to 5 times the retail value)
health-crime-fake-drug.law: Act on Special Measures for the Control of Public Health Crimes, Article 3

options.harmful: The medicine is seriously harmful to the human body
options.large: Annual retail value of KRW 10 million or more
options.death: Someone died or was injured by a harmful product

record.label: Prior punishment for the same type of crime

notes: A fine of 2 to 5 times the retail value of the product must always be imposed as well.
If the product is food mainly eaten by children or similar groups, it is handled more heavily.

medical-unlicensed-practice.name: Practicing medicine without a license
medical-unlicensed-practice.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million (increased, e.g. to up to 7 years in prison, if someone is injured)

options.pro: Performed medical acts such as procedures, injections or acupuncture on a continuing basis
options.paid: Performed acupuncture or similar for payment, but not really as a business
options.light: Cosmetic procedures such as eyebrow tattooing, unpaid acupuncture for neighbors or acquaintances, etc.

rec.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

harm.label: Was the method very harmful to the human body, or was anyone injured or killed?

tiers.note: If a method very harmful to the human body was used or someone was injured or killed, detention may be considered.

notes: If it was done as a business to make money, the Act on Special Measures for the Control of Public Health Crimes applies and it becomes much heavier.
The statutory penalty has risen since 2016, so the actual handling may be heavier than this estimate.

medical-unqualified-massage.name: Massage without a qualification (worker or owner)
medical-unqualified-massage.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million

rec.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

five.label: Did 5 or more people give massages?

notes: It may be lighter if massage was offered on the side of a barber business, or if a properly reported massage clinic hired unqualified workers.
The statutory penalty has risen since 2016, so the actual handling may be heavier than this estimate.

hygiene-unreported-business.name: Running a public health business without reporting it (lodging, bathhouse, barber or beauty, laundry, etc.)
hygiene-unreported-business.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million (for lodging businesses, up to 2 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million)
hygiene-unreported-business.law: Public Health Control Act, Articles 20(1) and (2)(1) and 3(1)

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

notes: Since a 2021 amendment, an unreported lodging business is punished separately and more heavily, with up to 2 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million.

hygiene-unlicensed-beautician.name: Running a barber or beauty business without a license, lending a license, etc.
hygiene-unlicensed-beautician.statutory: A fine of up to KRW 3 million

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

foodsan-unreported-restaurant.name: Running a restaurant without reporting it, or not reporting a business takeover
foodsan-unreported-restaurant.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million

small.label: Is it a small livelihood business, for example around 30 m² with monthly sales under KRW 1 million?

tiers.note: For a small livelihood business, a suspension of indictment is possible.

notes: If the annual retail value of the food sold is KRW 50 million or more, it may be punished more heavily under the Act on Special Measures for the Control of Public Health Crimes.

foodsan-hostess.name: Hostess entertainment or arranging it (at ordinary restaurants, etc.)
foodsan-hostess.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

small.label: Is it a small, low-income business?

foodimport-unreported.name: Importing food without an import report, or running an unregistered imported food business
aliases: Imported Food Safety Control Act violation
foodimport-unreported.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million (both may be imposed)
foodimport-unreported.law: Special Act on Imported Food Safety Control, Article 42(1) and (2)

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

small.label: Is it a small, low-income business, for example with annual sales under KRW 10 million?

tiers.note: If the import or sales amount is KRW 100 million or more, or KRW 50 million or more with a prior conviction of the same type, detention may be considered.
As a rule, a fine is imposed together.
The standard is 30% of the import or sales amount or the profit gained, whichever is higher.

notes: Since February 2016, food import reports have been governed by this Act instead of the Food Sanitation Act.

tobacco-unlicensed-retail.name: Selling tobacco without being designated as a retailer
tobacco-unlicensed-retail.statutory: Up to 6 months in prison or a fine of up to KRW 5 million

street.label: Did you sell at a street stall?

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

tiers.note: For a street vendor's first offense, a suspension of indictment is possible.

quarantine-evasion.name: Evading quarantine inspection, refusing isolation measures, etc.
quarantine-evasion.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

livestock-culling-order-breach.name: Violating an animal culling order, or importing in breach of quarantine
aliases: bringing in meat products without quarantine
bringing beef jerky or sausages into Korea
livestock-culling-order-breach.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
livestock-culling-order-breach.law: Act on the Prevention of Contagious Animal Diseases, Article 56

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

money.label: Was it a deliberate act to make money?

large.label: Was it on a large scale or repeated several times?

customs-smuggling-export.name: Smuggling goods out of Korea (exporting without declaration or under a false declaration)
customs-smuggling-export.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to the cost of the goods

cost.label: Cost of the goods (total if more than one case)

strategic.label: Are the goods strategic items or similar?

tiers.sentence: 1 year 8 months to 3 years in prison

tiers.note: 10% or more of the cost of the goods.

notes: Smuggled export goods are always confiscated (or their value collected).

customs-tax-evasion.name: Customs duty evasion (false declaration of price or tariff rate)
aliases: false country of origin for lower duty
customs-tax-evasion.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to 5 times the evaded duty or the cost of the goods, whichever is higher

paid.label: Have you paid all the duty assessed?

tiers.note: A fine of about 30% of the evaded duty is also requested.
2/3 of the evaded duty, reduced again by 2/3.
2/3 or more of the evaded duty.

notes: If the evaded duty is KRW 50 million or more, the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes applies.
Customs usually files a criminal complaint when the evaded duty is KRW 10 million or more.

prost-advertising.name: Advertising prostitution
prost-advertising.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
prost-advertising.law: Act on the Punishment of Arrangement of Commercial Sex Acts, Article 20(1)

online.label: Did you advertise online, or in places where children and youth need protection, such as near schools?

record.label: Prior conviction of the same type (repeat offense)

notes: Money and property obtained through the crime are confiscated or collected.

prost-coercion.name: Forcing someone into prostitution by violence, threats, deception, etc.
prost-coercion.statutory: Up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 100 million
prost-coercion.law: Act on the Punishment of Arrangement of Commercial Sex Acts, Article 18(1)(1) to (3)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: A fine is requested together (except in lighter cases, such as a short period of business with little profit). The sentencing guidelines apply.
Money and property obtained through the crime are confiscated or collected.
If the victim is a person with a disability, the request is one step heavier.

music-karaoke-hostess.name: Hiring hostesses at a karaoke room, or arranging prostitution
music-karaoke-hostess.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
music-karaoke-hostess.law: Music Industry Promotion Act, Articles 34(2) and 22(1)(4) and (5)

habit.label: Did you habitually arrange or provide prostitution?

tiers.note: It becomes heavier depending on the size of the business, the period of operation and prior convictions.

online-obscenity.name: Distributing obscene material online
online-obscenity.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million
online-obscenity.law: Information and Communications Network Act, Articles 74(1)(2) and 44-7(1)(1)

commercial.label: Did you upload a large amount to make money?

record.label: Do you have a prior conviction of the same type?

notes: If the material is sexual exploitation material involving children or youth, or illegally filmed material, other much heavier laws apply.

p2-csam-possession.name: Buying, possessing or viewing child or youth sexual exploitation material
p2-csam-possession.statutory: 1 year or more in prison for a fixed term
p2-csam-possession.law: Act on the Protection of Children and Youth against Sex Offenses, Article 11(5)

circ.label: Which better describes the circumstances of the case?
circ.help: A settlement with or compensation of the victim, sincere remorse and no prior punishment are mitigating; a planned offense, serious harm and a prior conviction of the same type are aggravating.

tiers.sentence: 1 year 8 months to 4 years in prison
1 year to 2 years 8 months in prison

notes: This applies when you buy, possess or view material knowing it is sexual exploitation material.
A 2020 amendment removed the fine and made the statutory penalty 1 year or more in prison for a fixed term.
There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

p2-juvenile-indecent-assault.name: Indecent assault on a child or youth, etc.
p2-juvenile-indecent-assault.statutory: 2 years or more in prison for a fixed term, or a fine of KRW 10 million to KRW 30 million
p2-juvenile-indecent-assault.law: Act on the Protection of Children and Youth against Sex Offenses, Article 7(3), (4) and (5)

bad.label: Is the offense of a serious nature, such as a prior conviction of the same type, a severe act or repeated acts?

tiers.sentence: 2 years to 3 years 4 months in prison
2 years to 3 years 4 months in prison
tiers.note: As a rule, the case goes to a formal trial with a prison sentence requested.

notes: The statutory fine has been raised (previously KRW 10 million to KRW 20 million).

new-minor-under-16.name: Sexual intercourse or indecent acts with a person aged 13 or over but under 16 (by a person aged 19 or over)
new-minor-under-16.statutory: Intercourse: 3 years or more in prison for a fixed term / Sexual acts similar to intercourse: 2 years or more in prison for a fixed term / Indecent acts: up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 15 million

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: A settlement or the victim not wanting punishment, compensation, deep remorse and a first offense are mitigating; a planned offense, serious harm and a prior conviction of the same type are aggravating.

tiers.sentence: 5 years 4 months to 8 years in prison
3 years 4 months to 6 years 8 months in prison
1 year 4 months to 4 years in prison
Up to 1 year 8 months in prison

notes: Since a 2020 amendment, a person aged 19 or over who has sex with, or commits indecent acts on, a person aged 13 or over but under 16 is punished even if the other person consented.
If the other person is under 13, it is punished regardless of the offender's age and much more heavily.
A final conviction may lead to registration of personal information and a ban on working at institutions related to children and youth.

p2-juvenile-solicitation.name: Luring or soliciting a child or youth to sell sex
p2-juvenile-solicitation.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million (increased by up to 1/2 for a child under 16 or a child with a disability)
p2-juvenile-solicitation.law: Act on the Protection of Children and Youth against Sex Offenses, Article 13(2)

bad.label: Is the offense of a serious nature, for example the child was very young, you have a prior record of the same type, or you repeated it to several children online?

tiers.note: For a first offense, the standard is a fine of KRW 5 million or more.

notes: The statutory penalty has been raised (previously up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million).

p2-workplace-sexual-intercourse.name: Sexual intercourse by abuse of occupational authority, etc.
aliases: sex by abuse of power at work
p2-workplace-sexual-intercourse.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million

bad.label: Is the offense of a serious nature, such as a strong hierarchical relationship or repeated acts?

tiers.note: If the relationship of dependence was strong or it was repeated, investigation in detention may be considered.
As a rule, the case goes to a formal trial with a prison sentence requested.

notes: This applies when someone has sexual intercourse, by deception or by using their power, with a person under their protection or supervision through work, employment or a similar relationship.
A 2018 amendment raised the statutory penalty (previously up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 15 million).

p2-home-invasion-rape.name: Rape or indecent assault after breaking into a home, etc.
aliases: breaking into a dormitory and assaulting
p2-home-invasion-rape.statutory: Life imprisonment or 7 years or more in prison
p2-home-invasion-rape.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes, Article 3(1)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: This applies when someone commits rape, imitative rape or indecent assault after breaking into another person's home or similar place, or while committing theft.
The statutory penalty has been raised (previously life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison).
There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

p2-weapon-carrying.name: Carrying a weapon, etc. (likely offender)
p2-weapon-carrying.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 3 million
p2-weapon-carrying.law: Punishment of Violences, etc. Act, Article 7

purpose.label: Was it connected to organized violence, or intended to harm someone?

tiers.sentence: 1 year 6 months or more in prison

tiers.note: Investigation in detention is the rule.

notes: This applies when, without a legitimate reason, someone carries or hands over a weapon or similar object that is likely to be used in a violent crime.

p2-public-weapon-display.name: Displaying a weapon in a public place
aliases: threatening with a knife in the street
p2-public-weapon-display.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million
notes: This applies when, without a legitimate reason, someone shows a weapon in a public place such as a road or park and makes people feel anxious or afraid (a crime newly created in 2025).

firearms-blade-possession.name: Possessing a sword, crossbow, spray weapon or stun gun without a permit
firearms-blade-possession.statutory: Swords and crossbows: up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million / Spray weapons and electric stun devices: up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million
firearms-blade-possession.law: Act on the Safety Management of Guns, Swords, Explosives, etc., Articles 70-2(1)(2-2), 71(1) and 12

crime.label: Was it for a criminal purpose, or connected to organized violence?

notes: A 2018 amendment made possessing a sword or crossbow without a permit punishable by up to 10 years in prison, so the actual handling may be heavier.

firearms-unlicensed-possession.name: Possessing firearms or explosives without a permit
firearms-unlicensed-possession.statutory: Pistols, rifles, hunting guns, air guns, etc.: 3 to 15 years in prison or a fine of KRW 30 million to KRW 100 million / Other firearms and explosives: up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million
firearms-unlicensed-possession.law: Act on the Safety Management of Guns, Swords, Explosives, etc., Articles 70(1)(2), 70-2(1)(2) and 12(1)

options.gun: Pistol, rifle, machine gun, cannon, hunting gun or air gun
options.other: Other firearms (tranquilizer guns, etc.) or explosives

crime.label: Was it for a criminal purpose, connected to organized violence, or a .22 caliber rifle for killing?

lowrisk.label: Is the danger very low, for example because it has little capacity to kill or injure?

tiers.note: Because the statutory penalty was raised, a fine must also be KRW 30 million or more.
The statutory minimum is 3 years.

tiers.sentence: 1 year 6 months or more in prison
tiers.note: A formal trial is the rule.

notes: Attempts are also punished.
A 2018 amendment sharply raised the statutory penalty for pistols, rifles, hunting guns, air guns, etc. to 3 to 15 years in prison, so the actual handling may be heavier.

p2-injury-death.name: Bodily injury causing death (including of a lineal ascendant)
p2-injury-death.statutory: Bodily injury causing death: 3 years or more in prison for a fixed term / Bodily injury causing the death of a lineal ascendant: life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

p2-assault-death.name: Assault causing death (including of a lineal ascendant)
p2-assault-death.statutory: Same as bodily injury causing death (3 years or more in prison for a fixed term; for a lineal ascendant, life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: This applies when an assault causes a person's death. Assault causing injury is handled by the same standard as bodily injury.
There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

p2-murder.name: Murder
p2-murder.statutory: Death penalty, life imprisonment, or 5 years or more in prison

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: A person who instigated or helped a murder is also, as a rule, detained.
Attempts are also punished.
There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

p2-human-trafficking.name: Human trafficking
p2-human-trafficking.statutory: Simple buying or selling: up to 7 years in prison / For indecent acts, sexual intercourse, marriage or profit: 1 to 10 years in prison / For exploitation, or transfer abroad: 2 to 15 years in prison (a fine of up to KRW 50 million may be added)

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: If the victim is under 18, it may be punished more heavily under the Child Welfare Act and other laws.
If the victim is released to a safe place, the penalty may be reduced.

p2-minor-kidnapping.name: Abduction or kidnapping of a minor
aliases: taking a child abroad without consent

tiers.note: This is a serious crime for which investigation in detention is, as a rule, considered.

notes: If the victim is under 13 and there is a certain purpose such as demanding money, the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes applies with much heavier penalties, such as 5 years or more in prison.
There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.

dv-protection-order-breach.name: Failure to comply with a domestic violence protective disposition or victim protection order
dv-protection-order-breach.statutory: Up to 2 years in prison, a fine of up to KRW 20 million, or short-term detention
dv-protection-order-breach.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Domestic Violence Crimes, Article 63(1)

priors.label: Number of past punishments for breaking a protective disposition or protection order

tiers.note: With 2 or more past breaches, a prison sentence may be requested at a formal trial.
For a repeat offense, a fine of about KRW 1 million to 1.5 million.
For a first offense, a fine of about KRW 800,000 to 1 million.

notes: This applies when you do not follow a protective disposition (such as a no-approach or no-contact order) after it becomes final, or break a court's victim protection order or temporary protection order.
Breaking a temporary measure taken by the police is punished separately, with up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million.

p2-habitual-gambling.name: Habitual gambling
p2-habitual-gambling.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million

minor.label: Was it a common kind of game, like Go-Stop, with small stakes?

tiers.note: A formal trial is the rule, and a fine may be imposed together.

tourism-illegal-casino.name: Running a casino without a permit
tourism-illegal-casino.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 70 million (both may be imposed)

options.owner: Owner, investor, nominal owner or key staff
options.manager: Middle manager (such as a floor or section manager) or dealer

big.label: Is it large-scale, organized or habitual?

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

tiers.note: For active participants such as repeat offenders, large-scale operators, investors, nominal owners and key staff, a formal trial is the rule.
An ordinary employee may receive a suspension of indictment, depending on prior convictions and the degree of involvement.

notes: A 2024 amendment raised the statutory penalty from up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million, and attempts are also punished.

sports-illegal-toto-operator.name: Running an illegal sports betting (Sports Toto) business (issuing look-alike betting tickets)
sports-illegal-toto-operator.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 70 million
sports-illegal-toto-operator.law: National Sports Promotion Act, Articles 47(2) and 26(1)

large.label: Did you operate on a large scale?

corp.label: Was it run as an organized, business-like operation, or do you have a prior conviction of the same type?

notes: Criminal proceeds are confiscated or collected, and a fine may be requested together.

personal-info-leak.name: Providing or leaking personal information without authorization
personal-info-leak.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

options.many: Information of many people (without a particular reason)

commercial.label: Did you provide it repeatedly to make money?

wantsPunish.label: Does the owner of the information want you punished?

notes: This covers providing information without consent, using it for other purposes, leaking information learned at work, and similar acts.

ictnet-intrusion.name: Intrusion into an information and communications network
aliases: Information and Communications Network Act violation
ictnet-intrusion.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million
ictnet-intrusion.law: Information and Communications Network Act, Articles 71(1)(11) and 48(1)

habit.label: Did you do it habitually and repeatedly?

repeat.label: Prior punishment for the same type of crime?

notes: Attempts are also punished.
A 2016 amendment raised the statutory penalty from up to 3 years in prison to up to 5 years in prison, so the actual handling may be heavier.

ictnet-secret-leak.name: Damaging another person's information, or infringing or leaking their secrets (other than hacking)
aliases: Information and Communications Network Act violation
ictnet-secret-leak.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million
ictnet-secret-leak.law: Information and Communications Network Act, Articles 71(1)(14) and 49

tiny.label: Was the amount of information leaked very small?

tiers.note: A formal trial is the rule.

notes: Since 2020, providing or leaking personal information without authorization has been punished under the Personal Information Protection Act.

ictnet-phishing-collect.name: Collecting other people's information by deception (phishing)
aliases: Information and Communications Network Act violation
ictnet-phishing-collect.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
ictnet-phishing-collect.law: Information and Communications Network Act, Articles 72(1)(2) and 49-2(1)

grave.label: Did you collect information of many people or financial or sensitive information, aim to make a lot of money, or keep repeating it?

once.label: Was it a one-time, unplanned act?

tiers.note: A formal trial is the rule.

commsecret-wiretap.name: Illegal wiretapping or recording other people's conversations, and disclosing them
aliases: Protection of Communications Secrets Act violation
commsecret-wiretap.statutory: 1 to 10 years in prison and suspension of qualifications for up to 5 years
commsecret-wiretap.law: Protection of Communications Secrets Act, Articles 16(1) and 3

repeat.label: Did you do it continuously or repeatedly?

bad.label: Is it connected to another illegal purpose?

tiers.note: There is no fine in the statutory penalty, so a formal trial is the rule.

notes: Recording a conversation you took part in yourself does not fall under this crime.

location-tracking.name: Secret location tracking (collecting personal location information without consent)
location-tracking.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
location-tracking.law: Act on the Protection, Use, etc. of Location Information, Articles 40(3) to (5) and 15

rec.label: Prior punishment for the same type of crime?

profit.label: Were you paid to do it (such as by an errand or investigation service), or was the purpose malicious?

notes: The same standard applies to obtaining location information by cloning another person's phone or misusing their information, and to violating an order to close the business.

p2-accidental-fire.name: Causing a fire by negligence
aliases: fire at a dormitory or factory
p2-accidental-fire.statutory: A fine of up to KRW 15 million

agreement.label: Did you settle with the victim?

tiers.note: If the damage is less than KRW 10,000,000, a fine smaller than the standard above is usual.
If the damage is less than KRW 10,000,000 and you settled, a suspension of indictment is possible.

p2-arson-dwelling.name: Arson of an inhabited building or public building
p2-arson-dwelling.statutory: Life imprisonment or 3 years or more in prison

exception.label: Was it unplanned, was the damage small, or did you settle with the victim?

tiers.note: If you set the fire knowing people were inside, investigation in detention is the rule regardless of casualties or the amount of damage.
If it was unplanned, or the damage was small and you settled, you may stand trial without detention.

notes: There is no fine for this crime, so if you are indicted you will face a formal trial.
Attempts, preparation and conspiracy are also punished.

wildlife-illegal-hunting.name: Illegal hunting (outside a hunting ground, outside the hunting season, or without a license)
wildlife-illegal-hunting.statutory: Up to 2 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million
wildlife-illegal-hunting.law: Wildlife Protection and Management Act, Article 69(1)(12) to (14)

gun.label: Did you use a gun or another dangerous method?

priors.label: Prior punishments for the same type of crime

tiers.note: It is increased taking into account the number of animals caught and prior convictions.
